title: What Will Replace Pull Requests? Rethinking Software Collaboration for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) coding agents has put pull requests under pressure: agents open millions of pull requests per month, while some open-source projects have begun to restrict or disable external contributions. We investigate which alternatives to pull requests practitioners are proposing or adopting and what these changes mean for empirical software engineering research. We reviewed 50 gray-literature documents from 31 organizations or individuals published between October 2025 and October 2026, coding the problems each named, the mechanisms it proposed or adopted, which of five roles of pull requests (integration, review, rationale, accountability, and external contribution) each mechanism takes over, and the evidence offered. translated_title: 什么将取代拉取请求？重新思考面向AI智能体的软件协作
translated_abstract: 人工智能编码智能体的兴起使拉取请求面临压力：智能体每月创建数百万个拉取请求，而一些开源项目已开始限制或禁用外部贡献。我们调查了从业者提出或采用了哪些拉取请求的替代方案，以及这些变化对实证软件工程研究意味着什么。我们审查了2025年10月至2026年10月间发布的来自31个组织或个人的50份灰色文献文档，对每份文档指出的 问题、其提出或采用的机制、每种机制接管了拉取请求五项功能（集成、审查、决策理由、问责和外部贡献）中的哪些，以及所提供的证据进行了编码。大多数应对措施以某种形式保留了拉取请求，无论是通过添加工具、附加新的工件，还是限制访问权限，而限制访问是最常被报告为一种临时的应对…
tldr: 该研究通过分析31个组织或个人的50份灰色文献，系统调查了AI编码智能体时代从业者提出的拉取请求替代机制，发现大多数方案仍以某种形式保留拉取请求，而非完全取代它。
en_tdlr: This study analyzes 50 gray-literature documents from 31 organizations to investigate alternatives to pull requests in the era of AI coding agents, finding that most responses retain pull requests in some form rather than fully replacing them.
